THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
01

Originals

All four supplied SVG files retain their original paths, effects and colors. The transparent yellow and green variants are available as separate downloads.

02

Template status

The feed, story and banner templates are proposed editable layouts. Check current platform crops and final copy before release.

03

Transparent logo backgrounds

Yellow transparent: Brand Green #39823C only. Green transparent: Brand Gold #F3CB2D only. Keep each original boxed file on its supplied background.

04

Naming

Use skm-campaign-name-channel-locale-v01. Keep a clear version and locale for every creative.
